name: PT Diamond Citra Propertindo Tbk
summary: PT Diamond Citra Propertindo Tbk engages in the real estate business activities in Indonesia. It provides real estate agency and brokerage services, as well as real estate management and valuation services; operates as an intermediary for buying, selling, and leasing real estate properties; and holds real estate wills. The company also engages in buying, selling, leasing, and operating real estate, such as apartment and residential buildings, as well as exhibition halls, private storage facilities, malls, shopping centers, and other facilities; and the provision of houses and flats or apartments with or without furniture for permanent use. In addition, it is involved in the land sale, building development, and real estate lot division activities, as well as land and operation of residential areas for movable homes. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Depok, Indonesia. PT Diamond Citra Propertindo Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Karya Permata Inovasi Indonesia.
